maya: CI turned red on nightly for //runtime/serve:session_tests, popping up intermittently on mac-16 and linux-arm builders
ci-bot: Build 4112349999 failed: //runtime/serve:session_tests (flake suspected) -- rerun queued
maya: stacktrace shows assertion in resume_sequence_timer(), but only on some seeds. running a local replay now. any quick ideas before I dig? :eyes:
ben: could be timer drift + preload race. did you see the flaky logs with 'kv-cache missing prefix' earlier?
maya: yes saw one noisy kv-prefetch log in the dump. attaching minimal snippet:
```
E runtime/session.cc:142 resume_sequence_timer(): expected ttl > 0, got 0
    at runtime::Session::resume_sequence_timer(Session...)\n```
andre: try a deterministic replay with seed sweep: `bazel test //runtime/... --test_arg=--replay --test_arg=--seed=12345` and also run with `--deterministic-timers` to see if it hides the flake
sasha: if it reproduces, bisect across recent commits touching kv-prefetch and session. I suspect the change in PR #4826 that added eager prefetch may change ordering under load
maya: ok running sweep now (seeds 1..50) on mac-16. will post back if I get a repro. also asking CI to re-run with verbose traces: @ci-bot can you kick an isolated rerun for that test on linux-x64? :pray:
ci-bot: Rerun requested by maya: `rerun build 4112349999 --target //runtime/serve:session_tests --platform linux-x64 --verbose-logs` queued as 4112350012
ben: if rerun stays green, try adding small sleeps in prefetched path to check for timing sensitivity (temporary local patch)
andre: another quick tip: run `TEST_SEED=42 TEST_REPLAY=1 ./tools/run_test.sh //runtime/serve:session_tests` — logs will include seed+event ordering so we can compare traces
maya: thanks. if I get a reproducible seed I'll open a bisect request and ping here with the seed and commit range. for now I'll let the rerun finish and post the trace. :thumbsup:
